resources.string:
Hints:
1. Put restriction policy values you want to make it nonfunctional to the below text area. One value one line. Then press the bottom right button to save.
2. To get restriction values, check [Constant Value] on here (Android developer references website).
3. You also can use [dumpsys device_policy](via adb shell or root) to check what restriction policies have applied on your device.
4. Please check the Xposed(LSPosed) log to see this module and policies loaded correctly or not.

Make user restriction policies (e.g. work profile policies) nonfunctional. Enable the module for "System Framework" (scope "system"), reboot once, then edit policies in the app - changes apply immediately.
5. Status: Connected to the Xposed framework. Saved policies apply immediately, no reboot needed.

5. Status: Not connected to the Xposed framework. Enable this module in LSPosed (scope: System Framework), reboot once, then open this app again. Policies you save now are kept and will sync when connected.
Saved locally. Not connected to the Xposed framework yet.
Saved locally, but syncing to the framework failed.
